_comment: Fixture pairs for tools/test-analyzer-fixtures.js. Each entry runs ReplayAnalyzer.compare against two real summaries from client/data/summaries/ and asserts the named expectations. The 'expect' block describes the target behaviour AFTER Phase 2-3 of the analyzer cleanup. Fixtures marked requiresPhase2=true are EXPECTED TO FAIL until those phases land — the harness exists partly to make the bug visible.

fixtures.name: self-match: Happy UD vs Happy UD (same replay)
same race, same build: HU footman 1116s vs HU footman 1011s
fixtures._note: We do NOT assert overall here — analyzer noise across two unrelated games (different opponents, different game flows) keeps the score in the 40s-60s even with the same build. The crucial assertion is that composition is NOT flagged divergent, since both built footmen.

fixtures.name: same race, DIFFERENT build (THE BUG): HU footman vs HU rifleman
different races: NE vs UD (matchup incompatible)
too-short replay: 4:52 UD vs 18:50 HU (durationOk false)
